column1: # tests/fixtures/migration-number/bh-7325-project-6-2026-10-17.tsv — BH-7325:
# the five migration-number collisions on example-org/project-6 (project-6-os,
# migrations_glob prisma/sql/*.sql) on 2026-10-17, replayed by
# tests/migration-number.bh-7325-test.sh in this order against ONE reservation
# store.
# SOURCE. The numbers were derived by the BH-7325 planner from a read-only
# clone, with these commands:
#   git clone --filter=blob:none https://github.com/example-org/project-6
#   main at T:        git rev-list -1 --before=<T> origin/HEAD
#   a PR's numbers:   its added prisma/sql/NNNN_*.sql names at its last commit before T
# The build box could not re-run them (egress to github.com denied on
# 2026-10-17 12:48Z), so the values are the plan's table, copied unchanged.
# NAMES. Only the NUMBERS are data. A name that is not in the ticket or the plan
# is a placeholder `NNNN_replay_<holder>`; 0158_agent_tool_call is the real name.
# A main column holds the highest numbers on main at T; lower numbers cannot
# change 1 + max, so they are left out.
# COLUMNS (tab-separated):
#   case  t_utc  pr  key  picked  main  open  taken_by  expected
#   key       TK-<pr>, a replay ticket key (the real keys are not in the plan)
#   picked    the NNNN(s) the build used, comma list
#   main      NNNN_name list on main at T
#   open      #n:NNNN_name list: the numbered files other open PRs added at T
#   taken_by  holder:NNNN list that made `picked` a collision (main or #n);
#             a holder that was not open at T (#1150 in C2 opened 39 s later)
#             is NOT in `open`: only a reservation could have kept them apart
#   expected  the number the allocator gives with the reservations of the
#             earlier rows in place
